quotes.text: So think about the difference, a chatbot is reactive, it waits for your next question. An agent is proactive, you give it a goal and it goes off and works on it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Draws the line between chatbots and agents in plain language.

quotes.text: What makes something an agent is the combination of three things. Reasoning, the ability to think through a problem. Tools, the ability to act on the world. And memory, the ability to remember what happened before
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A compact, reusable definition of an AI agent.

quotes.text: You define an agent's behavior in a YAML file. That means your agent configuration is version controllable, put it in Git, review it in pull requests, deploy it through CI/CD pipelines.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows why declarative agent definitions matter for enterprise engineering.

quotes.text: Instead of telling employees don't use AI, you can say use these agents instead. They're safe, they're governed, and they work with your data.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: The agent framework is how you build your agents and foundry is where they live and run.

takeaways: An AI agent combines reasoning, tools and memory so it can plan and act toward a goal instead of only answering questions like a chatbot.
Microsoft Agent Framework unifies Semantic Kernel and AutoGen into one open-source SDK for Python and .NET with agents, workflows, MCP tools, memory and human-in-the-loop approvals.
Developers build with the framework and deploy to Foundry, while Copilot Studio offers a low-code path, and both let organizations replace shadow AI with governed agents in Teams and Copilot.
hook: AI agents are everywhere in headlines, yet few people can explain what they are or which framework to build them with. This episode is for developers, IT leaders and business decision makers exploring agents in Microsoft environments. You learn what Microsoft Agent Framework is, how its building blocks work and where it fits next to Foundry, Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
